title: Narrow the Core2 five-instance HCI ACK failure to delayed HLI delivery

execution.environment: macOS Apple Silicon; Python 3.13; Node 20; QEMU virtual-device

checks.name: ack_state_observability
checks.detail: hci_ack pointer and semaphore-count branch are visible only with packet trace opt-in

checks.name: documentation_reconciliation
checks.detail: catalog/profile metadata and current docs label 4.506306s as host trace time, not guest virtual time

checks.name: default_runtime_path
checks.detail: trace-off single lease passes with HLI 45/45 and zero errors/reset/panic

checks.name: zero_stagger_five_instances
checks.detail: 3/5 pass; first response reached HLI after a 4.506306s host-trace timestamp delta and late Reset Complete packets broke command/ACK pairing

checks.name: root_cause_scope
checks.detail: delayed HLI delivery and response ordering are demonstrated; exact QEMU/controller scheduling mechanism still needs a fix

checks.name: behavioral_fix
checks.detail: schedule-on-rx, pending observation, H2C ready gate and multi-flight posts were unstable and not merged

notes: The initial ACK pointer and semaphore count are empty, so stale ACK pointer/semaphore-state corruption is not the first failure.
The first Reset Complete returned by Bumble reached HLI 4.506306 seconds later in host trace time.
Late Reset Complete packets crossed a new 0x1001 command and caused process-ack error 12.
The final LoadProhibited at 0x402630cc is secondary to the reset loop.
No unstable behavioral workaround was merged.
